notes.title: New game about Porfirio is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/823800/Kitty_Play/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25421252/063d1b15645850312d78516d76f8b624b861b2c0.jpg[/img][/url]

Is it easy to be a kitten?
Our arcade sim of a fluffy pet's life is now available on Steam!
Fascinating adventures, a variety of minigames and a charming little hero await you in Kitty Play, a game for everyone.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/823800/Kitty_Play/

notes.title: Fixed a problem with the game launch on some system configurations
notes.content: Fixed DEP problem. Now no need to add game.exe file to DEP exception list on some system configurations.
